functions.name: writeRgb565Pixel
functions.signature: (type $t14) (param $p0 i32) (param $p1 i32) (param $p2 i32) (param $p3 i32) (param $p4 i32) (param $p5 i32) (param $p6 i32) (param $p7 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: Expands five-bit source channels through the 132560 palette table; modes 1/2/4 blend, saturate and multiply; other modes copy.

validation.comparison: Every case checks the call result and the written RGB565 word. 12 cases compare all 67,108,864 memory bytes and the stack pointer. Coverage includes modes -1..8, five source words, four colour triples including wrapped operands, alpha variants, coordinates, all 32 palette entries and boundary traps.
limitations: Callers own surface descriptors and pixel addresses.
The palette table at 132560 must be populated, as in the original.
Mode 1 uses the original 0x0FE0 green mask, preserving its carry into bit 11.
Ledger: 340 client bodies recovered and 3,905 remain machine code.
